name: Google Storey County

timeline.event: Building 1, which was first operational in 2021, has increased power capacity by about 75%. This is based on the expansion of the dry cooling array from 4 to 7 columns (seen on Google Earth). Its backup generators also grew from 18 to 33…
Building 2 now has generators in place, but there is still a crane and construction work present.
Building 2 is operational. Based on a Google Earth image showing complete building shell, mechanical equipment and generators, plus cars parked at the front.
Building 3 foundation is underway. Building 2 exterior looks totally clean/landscaped.
Building 3 has a partially complete shell, electrical and mechanical equipment. Building 4 foundation is underway.

explain: Google Storey County is an operating AI data center in Storey County, NV, owned by google. Epoch AI estimates it draws 161 MW today and 389 MW when finished.
